title: Thousands of mourners gather in Belgrade for war criminal Mladic's funeral
summary: Thousands of mourners on Monday gathered at a church in Belgrade to view the body of Ratko Mladic, who died in The Hague, Netherlands, on August 27 while serving a life sentence for genocide, war crimes and crimes against humanity.
